skill.title: OA-Target
skill.guidance: Lock the exact measure, observation periods, fiscal/calendar basis, reporting vintage, requested statistic, output unit and format; a percentage numeric scale is distinct from its percent symbol. Source amounts only from acquired evidence. Search hits locate a source; they are not automatically the correct table, column or value. Focus on the single missing target field.

skill.title: OA-Locate
skill.goal: Acquire the relevant source with bounded search
skill.guidance: Use a narrow file scope and distinctive measure. The scoped_search Program can batch search and read real hit paths/offsets within this task budget. A returned ok proves only acquired source windows; it does not establish table/period alignment or a final answer. After empty hits vary one query dimension. Read the exact hit and nearby header/unit; do not repeatedly expand to the whole corpus or treat an exhausted search as complete target coverage.

skill.title: OA-Align
skill.goal: Bind quantities to the actual header, period and unit
skill.guidance: Align the title, header, row, footnotes, period and unit before using adjacent OCR numbers. Use table_extract only with a complete relevant table window and exact column/row labels. Ambiguous OCR needs native read_context, not guessed cells. Keep each operand with its source_ref and exact quote in evidence_state; name it by its computation field (e.g. numerator, denominator, from_value, to_value, values.0). Preserve period order and missing observations; never fill gaps. Accumulate operands across rounds; repeated reports are deduplicated. Retrieve only missing observation periods in human_office_progress.period_coverage. Conflicting values need explicit source disambiguation; to correct a record, supply replaces_source_ref for that exact old source. Gross/net, offered/accepted, old/new securities, currency quotation direction and 32nds are different quantities, not interchangeable units.

skill.title: OA-Compute
skill.guidance: Use series_metrics for its listed formulas when it fits; otherwise use existing temporary Python. Difference names FROM and TO plus absolute; ratio names numerator and denominator; change/growth names base_value and new_value. Set output_percent explicitly, never multiply twice. periods means elapsed intervals, not number of observations. Programs prove local arithmetic only. Persist the computed output via answer_candidate.result_ref with matching operation, output_unit and covers_task. Choose an actual scalar path from recent_scalar_result_refs, never its parent dictionary. Only the current executed operands need bindings; use answer_candidate.operand_bindings by operand name to disambiguate saved sources. Temporary Python may return operand_values alongside answer to retain its binding. If the target is solved, finish now rather than search again for the same quantity.

skill.title: OA-Commit
skill.goal: Submit the best supported result through the native protocol
skill.guidance: If the exact requested target has been computed from the required observations, immediately use native runtime_step(action="finish", answer=<only the requested numeric/list/date payload>). No XML tags. For percentages keep the numeric scale and omit a trailing percent symbol unless the question explicitly requires it in a template. Do not restart a broad search or replace a grounded value with an unverified one. A candidate is not semantic certification: check its target, direction, period, unit and precision against its actual evidence. When forced to finish, preserve the best genuinely supported result and remaining uncertainty; do not invent a completion receipt.
